title: World Knowledge Workspace & Canonical Entity Views
objective: Deliver a unified wiki-like authoring, search and reference workspace over existing canonical World, Character, relationship, Adventure/Project, Event and creator-content entities, with attached notes/lore/source material, backlinks, semantic relationships, templates and visibility-safe reader/GM projections rather than a parallel article database.

bounded_contract.canonical_entity_contract: WCI-01 projects stable references to canonical World, Character, relationship, Adventure/Project, Event and creator-content owners; entity views, templates, notes, lore and source attachments cannot mint competing canonical identity or become a second world/campaign ledger.
bounded_contract.annotation_contract: Notes, lore, source material and user tags remain scoped annotation/reference projections with explicit provenance and visibility; their existence does not promote them into canonical owner state or source taxonomy.
bounded_contract.backlink_relationship_contract: Backlinks and WCI semantic relationships are derived/reference projections over stable canonical entity identities and authorized attachment references; they do not replace canonical relationship ownership.
bounded_contract.visibility_contract: Authorization and visibility filtering precede search, counts, summaries, backlinks, reader/GM projections and AI context; hidden/GM/private creator inventory and protected cardinality cannot leak through aggregate output.
bounded_contract.template_contract: Templates shape authoring presentation/required fields only and cannot define canonical domain authority, permission grants or automatic canon promotion.
bounded_contract.accessibility_contract: Consequential entity references, annotations and relationship/backlink results require accessible nonvisual summaries/equivalents; the visual workspace is not exclusive truth.
bounded_contract.determinism_contract: Equivalent authorized inputs produce stable ordering and deterministic projection/receipt output independent of view or platform; wall-clock timing is not semantic truth.
bounded_contract.persistence_decision: No durable WCI-01 persistence is required for this tranche; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
bounded_contract.family_transition_contract: The application ACTIVE_FAMILY_CONTRACT must transition once from completed SSA to WCI before the WCI-01 RED run so the selector reaches the intended missing-feature acceptance failure rather than rejecting the new family.
bounded_contract.successor_boundary: WCI-02+, KFR-01+, public/community publishing, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

acceptance_contract: Test-first RED must prove the bounded WCI-01 contract/workspace surface does not exist before production implementation, after the current-family contract has transitioned from SSA to WCI.

One workspace projection must expose authorized canonical entity views plus attached notes/lore/source material, backlinks, semantic relationships and templates without a parallel article/world/campaign ledger.
Stable canonical entity identity and provenance must survive search, reference, backlink and template projections.
User notes/tags remain scoped annotations and cannot silently become canonical taxonomy, owner state or permission grants.
Hidden/GM/private creator content and protected cardinality must be filtered before search, counts, summaries, backlinks, reader projections and AI context.
Consequential workspace results require accessible nonvisual equivalents and deterministic ordering/receipts.
No canonical owner mutation, durable WCI-01 persistence, migration 0022, public publishing, provider activation or WCI-02 ownership is introduced.
Final validation uses exactly one WCI-01 current-family profile, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparator with zero historical predecessor fanout.
preserved_boundaries: SSA-01 through SSA-10 remain completed_verified with retired implementation authority.
World, Character, relationship, Adventure/Project, Event, creator-content, Permission/visibility, SSA, MAI, ISE, AAI and LNG owner authorities remain canonical.
WCI-01 creates workspace/projection semantics only and no parallel World, Character, relationship, campaign, source-taxonomy or publishing ledger.
User notes/tags and attached lore/source material do not become canonical truth by existence.
Visibility filtering precedes all search, counts, summaries, backlinks, reader/GM projections and AI context.
No durable WCI-01 ledger or migration 0022 is introduced.
WCI-02+, KFR-01+, public/community publishing, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
